This updates adds TM items to the AP world. Below is an overview of what they do and how to use them. These notes are included in the setup guide.

---

## TM Commands

Players can use TMs received through Archipelago to permanently replace one of a Pokémon's four moves. Each TM can only be used once, and assignments are saved on the server to persist between sessions.

### Assign a TM

```
/tm <TM Number> <Location> <Pokedex Number> <Move Slot>
```

**Example:**
```
/tm 34 "Pika Cup" 25 CU
```

This teaches Pikachu Rock Slide in Pika Cup, replacing its C-Up move.

**Locations:** `GLC`, `"Poke Cup"`, `"Prime Cup"`, `"Pika Cup"`, `"Petit Cup"`

**Move Slots:** `CU` (C-Up), `CD` (C-Down), `CL` (C-Left), `CR` (C-Right)

### Available TMs

| TM | Move |
|---|---|
| TM34 | Rock Slide |
| TM11 | Ice Beam |
| TM24 | Thunderbolt |
| TM21 | Body Slam |
| TM06 | Drill Peck |
| TM46 | Thunder Wave |
| TM38 | Flamethrower |
| TM27 | Earthquake |

### Check TM Usage

- `/tmstatus` — Lists all used TMs and their assignments.
- `/tmstatus 34` — Shows the assignment for TM34 or whether it is unused.

**Important:** TMs must be received before they can be assigned. Assignments are permanent, so double-check the Pokémon, location, and move slot before using a TM.
